title: Tenant authorisation in every resolver, Lambda and storage path
description:
What: every data rule, function and S3 path checks the caller's tenant, not only a group. Includes the cross-tenant negative test suite (reads, writes, objects, snapshots, search).
Acceptance:
Scenario: Tenant A's editor cannot touch tenant B
  Given editor tokens for tenants A and B
  When A's token reads or writes any of B's rows, objects or snapshots
  Then every attempt is denied
